competing_explanation: If 8x8 pooled Chamfer scale estimation and separable Rademacher BF16 micro-secant generation save less than 8.5 ms on dcgan_performance_r256, median update time will remain > 100.0 ms as in t2-secant-v1 (108.43 ms).
